newsitem.title: USA: Versace "targeted" in slaying - Miami police.
newsitem.headline: Versace "targeted" in slaying - Miami police.

text.p: Miami Beach Police Chief Richard Barreto said on Tuesday he believed fashion designer Gianni Versace, murdered earlier in the day, was "targeted".
"I believe he was targeted, yes," Barreto told a news conference in response to a question. He had said earlier that robbery did not appear to be a motive in the shooting.
"There was apparently no robbery attempt involved," Barreto said earlier in a prepared statement.

Dade County Mayor Alex Penelas, who has jurisdiction over the several cities that make up Greater Miami, told the news conference: "The information that we now have suggests that this terrible crime was an extraordinary occurrence and not just a random robbery."
Neither he nor Barreto gave any more details.
Versace was shot twice in the head at close range outside his Miami Beach mansion shortly before 9 a.m. (1300 GMT) by a gunman who immediately fled.
